about: Registry of original, parameterised visual templates. Parameter schemas here are the single source of truth for both the Python verifier (tools/visuals.py) and the browser renderer (web/js/visuals/). A published question references {template, version, params}. A new version must be added (never edit the meaning of a published version). Status must be 'approved' (human review) before a question using the template can be published.

templates.title: Likestrømskrets
templates.description: Ideal DC source with 1–3 resistors in series or 2–3 in parallel, optional ideal ammeter and voltmeter. Meter readings are computed from the circuit (never typed in), so they cannot contradict Ohm's law.
templates.idealised: Ideell spenningskilde (ingen indre motstand), ideelle måleinstrumenter og ledninger uten motstand.

review_log.note: Tegninger gjengitt og inspisert (polaritet, strømretning, etiketter, skjulte verdier).
Re-approved after layout changes for phone screens (no values changed)
Re-approved: optional internal resistance in series circuits and name-only resistor labels (existing figures unchanged)

templates.title: Vekselstrømskrets
templates.description: Sinusoidal AC source driving a single resistor, capacitor or inductor. Optional labels for frequency, RMS voltage, component value and reactance (value or '?'); reactance and current are computed.
templates.idealised: Ideell sinusformet kilde og ideell komponent (ingen tap eller parasittiske egenskaper).

review_log.note: Tegninger gjengitt og inspisert (polaritet, strømretning, etiketter, skjulte verdier).

templates.title: Kurveform
templates.description: One or two periodic waveforms plotted from their mathematical definition against time, with optional markers for peak, peak-to-peak, period and RMS of the first trace.
templates.idealised: Matematisk ideelle kurveformer.

review_log.note: Tegninger gjengitt og inspisert (polaritet, strømretning, etiketter, skjulte verdier).
Re-approved after layout changes for phone screens (no values changed)

templates.title: Blokkskjema
templates.description: Signal chain of labelled blocks from left to right, with up to three side blocks feeding into a chain block (e.g. a local oscillator into a mixer). Any block can be hidden ('?') or highlighted.
templates.idealised: Forenklet funksjonell oversikt, ikke et koblingsskjema.

review_log.note: Tegninger gjengitt og inspisert (polaritet, strømretning, etiketter, skjulte verdier).
Re-approved after layout changes for phone screens (no values changed)
One side block per chain block; all other figures unchanged

templates.title: Krets med R, C og L
templates.description: One to three resistors, capacitors and/or inductors in series or parallel, alone between two terminals or connected to a DC or AC source (optionally with an open switch). Totals, reactances, impedance, time constant and resonance frequency are computed; a capacitor or coil can instead be labelled by a given reactance (reactance_ohms). label_style: 'values' (default), 'names' (component names only, for concept questions) or 'source' (source values shown, components by name). current_arrow (0–1) draws the current as an arrow whose length follows it (series circuit with a source; for animations).
templates.idealised: Ideelle komponenter og ledninger uten motstand; ingen kobling mellom spolene.

review_log.note: Nye figurmaler, tegninger gjengitt og inspisert.
Re-approved after adding reactance labels and the source label style
Re-approved after layout changes for phone screens (no values changed)
Re-approved: horizontal coils drawn with their turns above the wire (no values changed)
Assumption text drops coil coupling when there is only one coil; drawing unchanged
Optional current_arrow added for animations; all published figures render identically (checked)

templates.title: Likeretter
templates.description: Half-wave (one diode) or bridge (four diodes) rectifier fed from an AC source, with optional reservoir/filter capacitor and load resistor. Also draws a simple diode detector (half-wave with C and R in parallel).
templates.idealised: Forenklet koblingsskjema. Diodene er tegnet slik at plussiden av utgangen er øverst.

review_log.note: Nye figurmaler, tegninger gjengitt og inspisert.
Re-approved: centre-tap kind added (existing figures unchanged)

templates.title: Transformator
templates.description: Transformer with AC source on the primary and an optional load on the secondary. Turns can be shown as numbers or as a ratio; secondary voltage and input impedance are computed.
templates.idealised: Ideell, tapsfri transformator.

review_log.note: Nye figurmaler, tegninger gjengitt og inspisert.

templates.title: Transistortrinn
templates.description: NPN common-emitter stage: collector resistor to the supply, optional emitter resistor with optional bypass capacitor, optional base voltage divider and coupling capacitors. Node voltages and collector current can be labelled with a value or '?'.
templates.idealised: Forenklet koblingsskjema av et forsterkertrinn med NPN-transistor.

review_log.note: Nye figurmaler, tegninger gjengitt og inspisert.
Re-approved: optional base resistor from the supply (existing figures unchanged)

templates.title: Spenningsregulator med serietransistor
templates.description: Linear series regulator: NPN pass transistor between input and output, base fed through a resistor from the input and held by a zener diode to ground, load at the output, optional input capacitor. Input/output voltage and load current are shown as values or '?'; the voltage across and the power in the pass transistor are computed.
templates.idealised: Forenklet koblingsskjema av en lineær spenningsregulator.

review_log.note: Reviewed rendered figure for q-0075
Re-approved: voltage labels moved under the terminals so the figure fits phones (no values changed)

templates.title: Zenerdiode med seriemotstand
templates.description: Simple zener voltage reference: a DC input feeds a zener diode to ground through a series resistor R, and the zener voltage is taken out at the output terminals. Input voltage, zener voltage and current are shown as values or '?'; the voltage across R and R itself are computed.
templates.idealised: Forenklet koblingsskjema. Zenerdioden regnes å holde spenningen sin konstant, og strømmen som trekkes på utgangen er neglisjerbar.

review_log.note: Reviewed rendered figure for q-0158
Labels moved so none overlap on phones (found by the new figure layout test); otherwise unchanged

templates.title: Frekvensrespons og spektrum
templates.description: Curves against frequency, computed from their definition: filter curves in dB with their −6 dB and −60 dB widths, a resonance curve with its half-power points (and optionally a frequency band on the curve), the spectrum of an AM or FM signal modulated with one tone, or the response of two coupled tuned circuits at different coupling. 'blank' draws only the axes with a note, for figures that are filled in after answering.
templates.idealised: Kurvene er regnet ut fra en forenklet modell og viser formen, ikke et bestemt filter eller apparat.

review_log.note: Reviewed rendered figures for q-0115, q-0053, q-0051, q-0213, q-0021, q-0197, q-0114
AM description names lower/upper sideband and says lower amplitude; frequency labels keep the value's own decimals; drawings unchanged

templates.title: Pi-filter
templates.description: Pi-filter (low-pass) at a transmitter output: variable capacitor C1 across the input, coil L in series (optionally with a band tap), variable capacitor C2 across the output. Optionally fed from a valve anode through a blocking capacitor with the anode voltage brought in through an RF choke. One part can be marked with a dashed frame, and the knob names TUNE/LOAD can be shown (typically only after answering).
templates.idealised: Forenklet koblingsskjema uten komponentverdier.

review_log.note: Reviewed rendered figure for q-0171

templates.title: Forholdsdetektor
templates.description: Simplified ratio detector (FM demodulator): tuned MF transformer with a centre-tapped secondary, two diodes the same way round the loop charging C3 and C4 (U1, U2), a large capacitor Cs across both, R1/R2 with their middle to ground, LF output between the C3/C4 junction and ground. show_curve adds the S-curve (output against frequency, through zero at f0), typically only after answering. marker_u marks an operating point on the S-curve (for animating the frequency swing).
templates.idealised: Forenklet koblingsskjema uten komponentverdier. Tertiærviklingen som mange forholdsdetektorer har, er utelatt.

review_log.note: Reviewed rendered figure for q-0117 (before and after answering)
Optional marker_u added for animations; the published figure renders identically (checked)

templates.title: Signal over tid
templates.description: Signals against time, computed from their definition and drawn as stacked panels: collector current in classes A/AB/B/C for a sine drive (conduction), a CW carrier keyed hard or softly (keying), the envelope of SSB speech, processed speech or RTTY with optional peak and average levels (envelope), an AM signal correctly modulated or overdriven with clipped peaks (am), a data signal with the carrier shifting between two frequencies (fsk), and the frequency of a keyed CW transmitter with or without chirp (chirp). 'blank' shows only a note, for figures shown after answering. bias sets the conduction drive's bias directly (the class label follows), and cursor draws a time cursor; both are for animations. Also: an oscillator's frequency drifting after switching on (drift, trace warmup).
templates.idealised: Forenklede kurver som viser formen, ikke målinger fra et bestemt apparat.

review_log.note: Reviewed rendered figures and animations in the preview (phone and desktop, before and after answering)
New kinds added for round 7; all published figures render identically (checked)

templates.title: Frekvensspekter
templates.description: A frequency axis with discrete spectrum lines (harmonics, mixing products), sidebands as bands, a noise skirt around a carrier (phase noise) and an optional filter passband drawn over it. One or two panels share the axis. Levels are relative (0–1). 'blank' shows only a note, for spectra shown after answering.
templates.idealised: Forenklet spekter som viser hvor signalene ligger, ikke en måling.

review_log.note: Reviewed rendered figures and animations in the preview (phone and desktop, before and after answering)
Labels moved so none overlap on phones (found by the new figure layout test); otherwise unchanged

templates.title: Halvleder
templates.description: Simplified drawings of the inside of a semiconductor: a silicon lattice with electron-pair bonds, optionally with a phosphorus atom (free electron) or boron atom (hole); a PN junction as a bar with holes, free electrons and the depletion layer with its fixed charges, optionally with anode/cathode, bias polarity, or a narrow and a wide layer compared (varicap); an N-channel JFET with gate regions and depletion layers, optionally at two gate voltages. 'blank' shows only a note, for drawings shown after answering. depletion_width (junction) and gate_bias (JFET, 0–1) set the layer width continuously, for animations.
templates.idealised: Forenklet tegning av prinsippet, ikke i riktig målestokk.

review_log.note: Reviewed rendered figures and animations in the preview (phone and desktop, before and after answering)
Labels moved so none overlap on phones (found by the new figure layout test); otherwise unchanged

templates.title: Trinn og komponenter
templates.description: Small circuit diagrams with IEC-style symbols: class C stage with an RF choke to the base, push-pull stage with centre-tapped transformers, 7812 regulator (reveal: decoupling capacitors at its pins), single-transistor mixer (collector load '?', reveal: tuned to the MF), dual-gate MOSFET (gate 2 '?', reveal: small positive voltage, decoupled), triode (reveal: grid slightly negative, anode high positive, electron flow), PNP transistor (reveal: base about 0,6 V below the emitter) and a quartz crystal. Also: the three transistor configurations side by side (configurations), an NPN transistor with IB, IC and IE (currents), and a parallel tuned circuit with the coil's loss as a series R (tank_loss).
templates.idealised: Forenklet koblingsskjema uten komponentverdier.

review_log.note: Reviewed rendered figures and animations in the preview (phone and desktop, before and after answering)
New kinds added for round 7; all published figures render identically (checked)
Dual-gate and push-pull layouts fixed (no overlapping labels); other figures unchanged
Labels moved so none overlap on phones (found by the new figure layout test); otherwise unchanged

templates.title: Illustrasjon
templates.description: Small explanatory drawings: the SI prefix ladder with a step marked (prefixes), a tolerance range on a number line (tolerance), an S-meter scale with two readings and optionally the dB per S-unit (s_meter), a plate capacitor with area and distance and optionally half the distance (plates), a variable capacitor's rotor and stator with the overlap shaded (variable_capacitor), two coils with parallel and optionally perpendicular axes (coils), and an oscillator and final stage on one supply line, optionally with a separate regulator (supply). 'blank' shows only a note. angle (−90 to 90°) turns the variable capacitor's rotor (for animations). Also: MOSFET transfer curves in depletion and enhancement mode (fet_transfer), the phasing method for SSB (phasing), an amplifier's output against drive with compression (transfer), an air-wound coil (air_coil) and a receiver's dynamic range (range). Also a band-plan edge between a CW segment and an all-modes segment, with an SSB signal tuned to one or two frequencies and its sideband drawn where it lands (band_edge).
templates.idealised: Forenklet illustrasjon av prinsippet.

review_log.note: Reviewed rendered figures and animations in the preview (phone and desktop, before and after answering)
New kinds added for round 7; all published figures render identically (checked)
New kind band_edge (LSB at a band-plan edge); all published figures render as before

templates.title: Kode delt opp i deler
templates.description: A short code (call sign, emission designator, signal report) drawn as 1–6 parts, each in a box with a bracket and a label underneath. A part's label can be hidden ('?') until after answering, and a part can be highlighted.
templates.idealised: Forenklet oppstilling av hva hver del av koden betyr.

review_log.note: Round 8 templates: checked rendered figures on desktop and phone, before and after answering, and the animations

templates.title: Måleinstrument
templates.description: Measuring instruments. scope: an oscilloscope screen with a 10 × 8 division graticule and 1–2 traces (sine, square or AM) computed from frequency, amplitude, time/div and volt/div, with the settings printed under the screen. meter_series: a moving-coil meter with a series resistor as a voltmeter (range, full-scale current, coil resistance; the resistor is computed). meter_shunt: the same meter with a shunt as an ammeter (the shunt is computed). voltmeter_loading: a voltage divider R1/R2 measured across R2 by a voltmeter with internal resistance R_i (the reading is computed). gate: two equal counter gate windows over one pulse train, opened at slightly different times, counting one pulse more or less. Hidden values are drawn as '?'.
templates.idealised: Ideelle komponenter og instrumenter utover det som er tegnet; forenklet tegning.

review_log.note: Round 8 templates: checked rendered figures on desktop and phone, before and after answering, and the animations

templates.title: Bølgeutbredelse
templates.description: How radio waves travel, drawn from the side and not to scale: the ionosphere's layers by day or night, or both (layers); a transmitter, its ground wave and rays at several elevation angles to one layer, each returning or escaping as computed from the frequency and the layer's critical frequency (secant law, flat earth), with the skip zone optionally shaded (sky_wave, animatable on f_mhz); 1–3 hops between ground and a layer with optional hop distances (hops); the radio horizon of two antennas on a curved earth, d ≈ 4·√h km (horizon); a ray trapped in a low duct over the sea (duct); two stations aiming north at the aurora (aurora); and two stations behind a sharp ridge with optional diffraction over the edge (knife_edge). 'blank' shows only a note.
templates.idealised: Forenklet sideriss, ikke i skala; strålene er tegnet som rette linjer som snur i én høyde.

review_log.note: Round 8 templates: checked rendered figures on desktop and phone, before and after answering, and the animations

templates.title: Digital signalbehandling
templates.description: Digital signal processing, computed from the definitions: a sine sampled at f_s with the samples on stems, optionally the analogue signal and the lowest-frequency sine through the samples (the alias above f_s/2) (samples); one period of a sine rounded to the levels of an n-bit converter and held (sample and hold), optionally with the step, the number of levels and the error at each sample (quantize); a noisy pulse and the output of an N-point moving average (moving_average); and the structure of a FIR filter (no feedback) and a first-order IIR filter (feedback) (fir_iir). bits and taps may be fractional for animations and are rounded.
templates.idealised: Forenklet tegning, regnet ut fra definisjonen.

review_log.note: Round 8 templates: checked rendered figures on desktop and phone, before and after answering, and the animations

templates.title: Fødekabel
templates.description: Feed lines. standing_wave: a line from the transmitter to a matched, open, shorted or resistive load (load_ratio = R/Z0), with the voltage (and current) along the line computed from the reflection coefficient, the instantaneous wave at phase_deg (for animations), optional Umax/Umin markers, a λ/4 mark from the load, an antenna tuner (ATU) at the transmitter and a computed SWR label. cable: a coax cross-section (parts named, optional diameters d and D) and/or a ladder line (optional opposite currents). quarter_wave: a λ/4 transformer with Z0, Z_L and the computed input impedance Z0²/Z_L. directional: transmitter, SWR meter and antenna with the forward and reflected waves (W or V); SWR and return loss computed from the readings.
templates.idealised: Tapsfri kabel og rent resistiv last; ikke i målestokk.

review_log.note: Round 8 templates: checked rendered figures on desktop and phone, before and after answering, and the animations

templates.title: Antenne
templates.description: Simplified antenna drawings: a half-wave dipole fed in the middle (coax, balun, ferrites or ladder line) with optional graphs of current and voltage along it (envelopes, or the instantaneous values at phase_deg for animations), a folded dipole, a ground-plane antenna with radials at an angle (optionally beside one with horizontal radials, and with the feed impedance), a Yagi-Uda seen from above (reflector, driven dipole, 0–6 directors), a quad loop, a dipole with traps (the parts outside the traps can be greyed out), a short vertical with a loading coil (optionally with the current along it), and computed radiation patterns seen from above (half-wave dipole, vertical, directional antenna with beamwidth and front/back ratio).
templates.idealised: Forenklet tegning av prinsippet, ikke i riktig målestokk. Strøm, spenning og strålingsdiagram er regnet ut fra en forenklet modell av en ideell antenne uten tap og uten påvirkning fra omgivelsene.

review_log.note: Round 8 templates: checked rendered figures on desktop and phone, before and after answering, and the animations

templates.title: Sikkerhet
templates.description: Drawings for electrical and practical safety: current paths through a person (body_paths, 'highlight' one with 'reveal'), a logarithmic current scale with the effects of 50 Hz current and where an RCD and a fuse act (shock_scale), an earth fault in an appliance with a fuse or a fuse and RCD (earth_fault; 'reveal' draws the fault current and what trips, 'leak_ma' labels a small leak), a mast and an overhead power line ('reveal' draws how far a falling mast reaches; mast_fall), a mobile radio's supply in a car with fuses in both leads ('reveal' breaks the engine's earth cable and draws the starter current through the radio's negative lead; car_supply), and a good and a dry solder joint in cross-section (solder_joint).
templates.idealised: Forenklet prinsippskisse.
